{{Quote|Shadows Six, Seven, and Ten were caught in the ray.|Ahsoka Tano|<ref name="som" />}}
'''Flyby''' was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served in [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]], a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Flyby&mdash;using the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "'''Shadow Six'''"&mdash;and his unit accompanied [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] on a [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|mission]] to destroy the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Warship/Legends|warship]] [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]. During the mission, Flyby piloted his [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]] through the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]], where he evaded massive [[Neebray/Legends|neebrays]] with the rest of his squadron. Arriving at the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]], which the ''Malevolence'' had taken as its target, the squadron was forced to escape an ion ray launched by the warship's [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]]. However, Flyby was unable to avoid the ray, and his starfighter was left disabled in [[Realspace/Legends|space]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|All right, boys, let's go.|Anakin Skywalker as he addressed Shadow Squadron, moments before they jumped to hyperspace|<ref name="som" />}}
[[File:ShadowSquadronYwings.png|thumb|left|250px|Shadow Squadron departs from the ''Resolute''.]]
The [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] nicknamed Flyby<ref name="incrediblevehicles">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref> served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[Shadow Squadron/Legends|Shadow Squadron]]&mdash;a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]&mdash;using the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "Shadow Six."<ref name="som" /> Born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], Flyby was [[Cloning/Legends|decanted]] from the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="db" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], after the [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|loss]] of a Republic task force in the [[Abregado system/Legends|Abregado system]],<ref name="rm">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref> the Republic learned about the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], a [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]]<ref name="tcwcg">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> constructed by [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps/Legends|Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]]<ref name="breakout">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 1: Breakout Squad]]''</ref> for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The [[Warship/Legends|warship]] possessed twin [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] that were capable of disabling enemy [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] devised a plan to stop the Confederate [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] from destroying the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]], which the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the ''Malevolence'', [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], had taken as his next target. Shadow Squadron, under the command of Skywalker; his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]; and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]; would take a [[Balmorra Run/Legends|shortcut]] to the [[Medcenter/Legends|medical center]] and attempt to destroy the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the ''Malevolence'' to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Grievous.<ref name="som" />

After departing from the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']] in [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]], Skywalker contacted Flyby and his squadmates, who checked in with their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General. The squadron jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and emerged at the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]].<ref name="som" /> Flyby&mdash;along with his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R5-U8/Legends|R5-U8]]<ref name="incrediblevehicles" />&mdash;followed his fellow pilots into the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]], where they faced massive [[Neebray/Legends|neebrays]] inhabiting it. Managing to evade the creatures without any casualties, Flyby and his squadron left the Kaliida Nebula behind them, arriving at the medical center. Soon after their arrival, the ''Malevolence'' emerged from hyperspace. Grievous ordered his ship's crew to target the approaching Republic starfighters and launched an ion ray from one of its ion cannons. Skywalker ordered the pilots to take evasive action, but Flyby was among several other pilots who were unable to pilot their BTL-B Y-wing starfighters away in [[Time/Legends|time]]. With his starfighter's power disabled, Flyby was left in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] while the rest of Shadow Squadron continued toward the ''Malevolence''.<ref name="som" />

==Personality and traits==
When the ''Malevolence'' launched an ion ray from one of its ion cannons, Flyby was unable to pilot his BTL-B Y-wing starfighter away from the ray in time, leaving his starfighter disabled.<ref name="som" /> He stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="db" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" />

==Behind the scenes==
Flyby first appeared, albeit unidentified, in "[[Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence'']]," the third episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]], which was released on [[October 10]], [[2008]]. The trooper was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who voices all clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] in the show.<ref name="epguide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode003.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref> Flyby was identified by name in the [[2011]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'' by [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="incrediblevehicles" />
